Ayase and I were sitting at the same place as last 
time.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Good grief.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
Whenever you mention something lewd, you often 
end up being insincere, Onii-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Is it that fun to see me embarrassed?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No, it's not like that.

It's just that my Lovely Angel Ayase-tan was so 
cute that I lost myself for a moment.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Geez... You're just saying that again.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Haha... You might be right.
Truth be told, I might've gone a little bit too far.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
Onii-san, you keep embarrassing me like this all the 
time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Look, I'm sorry.

I don't really have any choice other than 
apologizing if I want to cheer Ayase up.
Seeing me like this, Ayase let out a little sigh.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Oh well, it's fine.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You'll forgive me?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Yes. We're good now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: So, what do we do now?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: If you don't mind, I'd like to...

Ayase hesitated for a moment and decided not to 
continue, instead turning to smile at me.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...No, I'm fine with anywhere you want to go, Onii-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ayase... Thank you.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: W-Why would you say that, all of a sudden?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Well, you pushed yourself pretty hard today, didn't 
you?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: I didn't...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
You don't have to hide it. When we went to check 
out doujinshi, you weren't really all that interested, 
were you?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: That's...
It's obvious if you think about it.

For someone who used to despise anything otaku, 
Ayase had been awfully positive today.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Sure, seeing you happy with a Meruru doujinshi in 
your hand made me happy too, but you know...

There's no way that she'd come to terms with this 
stuff so easily.

I mean if that's how it went, this girl, who loves 
Kirino so much, wouldn't end up fighting with her 
all the time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Everything you've done today was for me so that I 
could stop worrying, wasn't it?

Ayase tried really hard today, just to prove that 
she and Kirino will never fight over these kinds of 
things anymore.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's why I want to thank you.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: You don't have to... If it's for you, Onii-san...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
That so? Okay, want to check out some of the 
deeper places then?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: O-Okay.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's decided then, let's see where we haven't been...

Opening Saori's humbly made map, I eagerly 
started searching for our next destination.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Um, Onii-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hm?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...No, it's nothing.

Ayase gave me a troubled smile and went silent 
after I replied without raising my head from the 
map.
...Oh, I see.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's okay, I won't take you to any strange places.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...Okay.
